verdict.rationale: Twenty documents first-party self-hosting via a single Docker Compose command. Its docs pitch this at privacy-conscious organizations that need to own their data end to end for regulatory or contractual reasons, so users decide where data lives by choosing their own infrastructure. The evidence never mentions choosing a storage region on the hosted twenty.com cloud. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the managed cloud offering, documented residency guarantees (e.g., EU/US hosting), independent corroboration.
